title: Recipe 63 — The harness learns from its own sessions

beats.label: Open the recipe
beats.cue: “Four commands that turn a pile of session logs into few-shots, an FAQ skill, and written-down lessons.”

beats.label: Start from a blank spec
beats.cue: live/ is scratch — nothing committed is touched by a take.

beats.label: Load the API key
beats.cue: [needs-key] Sources demos/.env for the run and optimize beats.

groups.title: Beat 1 · a harness with a history to mine

beats.label: Type a harness
beats.cue: “All four verbs read .crewhaus/sessions — so first, something that writes there.”

beats.label: Compile it and check it
beats.cue: “--check: GREEN. Self-knowledge is a set of verbs over session logs, not a spec feature.”

verify.note: GREEN — assertion ok; install ok; boot gated at the provider credentials gate

groups.title: Beat 2 · the empty state is the honest state

beats.label: Ask for the few-shot pool
beats.cue: “No pool yet — and it names the exact path it looked in rather than returning an empty list.”

verify.note: exit 1 — `no few-shot pool at <cwd>/.crewhaus/...`; harvest has to run first

beats.label: Read it
beats.cue: “A tool that fabricates examples from no data would be worse than one that refuses.”

beats.label: Try harvesting
beats.cue: “Same answer, same honesty: no sessions, no harvest.”

beats.label: Read it
beats.cue: “--min-score 0.8: only the turns that actually went well become examples.”

beats.label: Read the session-summarize contract
beats.cue: “The one verb that works on an empty machine — because it's about retention, not mining.”

beats.label: Read it
beats.cue: “--evicted --ttl-days: summarize what you're about to delete, so ageing out isn't forgetting.”

beats.label: Run the agent a few times
beats.cue: [needs-key] “The recipe's precondition is boring and unavoidable: you have to use it before it can learn from you.”

verify.note: interactive REPL; needs a model credential

beats.label: Ask it something typical
beats.cue: [needs-key] “Typical is the word that matters — few-shots harvested from edge cases teach the wrong lesson.”
beats.text: What does the compiler emit for a cli target?

groups.title: One more thing · the four verbs, for real

beats.label: Harvest the good turns
beats.cue: [needs-key] “The high-scoring turns become a few-shot pool the optimizer can draw on.”

beats.label: Distill an FAQ skill
beats.cue: [needs-key] “--min-occurrences: a question asked once is noise; asked ten times it's a skill.”

beats.label: Write down the lessons
beats.cue: [needs-key] “The low-scoring turns become lessons — the harness's own record of what it got wrong.”

beats.label: Feed the pool to optimize
beats.cue: [needs-key] “--few-shot auto resolves the harvested pool. The harness teaching itself, with a measured gate.”

beats.label: Read the per-user path
beats.cue: “crewhaus run --user max injects that user's lessons. Self-knowledge can be scoped to a person.”
